entries.title: II Chronicles 10:1
segments: And Rehoboam went to Shechem. For all Israel had come [to] Shechem to make him king.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:2
segments: And it happened when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who [was] in Egypt where he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard [it], Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:3
segments: And they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:4
segments: Your father made our yoke heavy. And now lighten the heavy service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:5
segments: And he said to them, Come again to me after three days. And the people departed.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:6
segments: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What advice do you give [me] to return answer to this people?

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:7
segments: And they spoke to him saying, If you are kind to this people and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be your servants forever.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:8
segments: But he departed from the advice which the old men gave him and listened to the young men who were brought up with him, who stood before him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:9
segments: And he said to them, What advice do you give that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Lighten the yoke which your father put on us?

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:10
segments: And the young men who were brought up with him spoke to him saying, In this way shall you answer the people who spoke to you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but you lighten our yoke, this you shall say to them, My little [finger]  shall be thicker than my father's loins.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:11
segments: And now my father put a heavy yoke on you, and I will surely add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I [will chastise you] with scorpions.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:12
segments: And Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day as the king commanded, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:13
segments: And the king answered them roughly. And king Rehoboam departed from the advice of the old men,

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:14
segments: and answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I [will chastise you] with scorpions.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:15
segments: And the king did not listen to the people, for [the] revolution was from God so that the LORD might perform His word which He spoke by the hand of Ahijah of Shiloh to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:16
segments: And all Israel [saw] that the king would not listen to them, and the people answered the king saying, What part do we have in David? And we have no inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, O Israel! Now, David, see to your own house. And all Israel went to their tents.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:17
segments: [As for] the sons of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:18
segments: And king Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who [was] over the forced labor. And the sons of Israel stoned him with stones so that he died. But king Rehoboam [was] warned to get up into [his] chariot to flee to Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Chronicles 10:19
segments: And Israel rebelled against the house of David until this day.
